title: Carnegie Said Dying Rich Was a Disgrace 📚

scenes.say: One of history's richest men believed dying rich was a disgrace.
Andrew Carnegie came to America in eighteen forty-eight. His first job, in a cotton mill, paid one dollar and twenty cents a week.
In nineteen oh one, he sold his steel company for four hundred and eighty million dollars.
Then he gave almost all of it away. Over two thousand five hundred libraries.
His rule? The man who dies thus rich dies disgraced. So what is your money for?

first_comment: If you had Carnegie's fortune, would you give most of it away? 👇
